models.equation_en: Id = 2 n beta Ut^2 (softplus(xs)^2 - softplus(xd)^2) (1 + lambda |Vds|). Pair-capacitor charges sum to zero.
models.equation_zh: 弱反型至强反型连续电流，另用守恒的固定互电容网络表示端口电荷。

parameters.small_signal_method: Analytic derivatives of the same DC law

models.limits_en: 0–1.8 V low-voltage demonstration. No avalanche, oxide leakage, DIBL, velocity saturation, intrinsic charge partition or measured fit. Not full EKV/BSIM.
models.limits_zh: 仅0–1.8V低压示意；无雪崩、栅漏、DIBL、速度饱和、内禀电荷分配或实测拟合；不是完整EKV/BSIM。
models.parameter_origin_en: Demonstration assumptions; SI constants k and q are exact.
models.parameter_origin_zh: 数值为演示假设；SI常数k与q采用精确定义。

models.equation_zh: 从C(V)积分得到Q(V)，瞬态位移电流为C(V)dV/dt。
models.limits_en: Depletion capacitance only, -20 <= V < 0.35 V. No forward diffusion charge, breakdown or series resistance. Reverse leakage is an assumed 1 pA.
models.limits_zh: 仅耗尽电容，-20≤V<0.35V；不含正向扩散电荷、击穿和串联电阻；反向漏电假设为1pA。
models.parameter_origin_en: Demonstration assumptions; SI constants k and q are exact.
models.parameter_origin_zh: 数值为演示假设；SI常数k与q采用精确定义。

models.equation_en: Ic=alphaF IF-IR; Ib=(1-alphaF)IF+(1-alphaR)IR; Ie=-IF+alphaR IR; alphaF IES=alphaR ICS=IS.
models.equation_zh: 分别求解正、反向结注入，三端电流满足KCL和互易关系。
models.limits_en: Generic silicon NPN, not a SiGe HBT. Low-injection DC only; no Early effect, high injection, transit time, RF fT or breakdown.
models.limits_zh: 通用硅NPN，不是SiGe HBT；仅低注入直流，不含Early效应、大注入、渡越时间、fT及击穿。
models.parameter_origin_en: Demonstration assumptions; SI constants k and q are exact.
models.parameter_origin_zh: 数值为演示假设；SI常数k与q采用精确定义。

models.equation_zh: 区分配对标准差和单管标准差，并演示共同偏移的抵消。
models.limits_en: Assumed Gaussian local mismatch and correlation. No foundry statistics, spatial-gradient fit, yield certification or temperature-dependent mismatch law.
models.limits_zh: 高斯局部失配和相关系数为假设；无工艺统计、空间梯度拟合、良率认证或温度失配律。
models.parameter_origin_en: Demonstration assumptions; SI constants k and q are exact.
models.parameter_origin_zh: 数值为演示假设；SI常数k与q采用精确定义。

models.equation_en: Solve Id1(Vs)+Id2(Vs)=Itail with bisection using A01; Vg1/2=Vcm +/- Vdiff/2.
models.equation_zh: 用A01求解共同源极电压，使两支路之和等于尾电流。
models.limits_en: Fixed drain biases and ideal tail source. No amplifier load, common-mode feedback, frequency compensation or finite tail impedance.
models.limits_zh: 固定漏端偏置、理想尾电流源；不含放大器负载、共模反馈、频率补偿及尾源有限阻抗。
models.parameter_origin_en: Demonstration assumptions; SI constants k and q are exact.
models.parameter_origin_zh: 数值为演示假设；SI常数k与q采用精确定义。

models.equation_en: Vbe=Vg0+(Vbe0-Vg0)T/T0-eta Ut ln(T/T0); deltaVbe=Ut ln(N); Vref=Vbe+a deltaVbe; dVref/dT|T0=0.
models.equation_zh: 一阶温漂在25°C相消，并保留VBE曲率；输出PTAT电流为deltaVbe/R1。
models.limits_en: Ideal voltage sum inspired by bandgap principles, not the 2.5 V Brokaw circuit reproduction. No start-up, PSRR, trimming, resistor TC, mismatch or output load.
models.limits_zh: 按带隙原理的理想电压合成，并非复现Brokaw的2.5V电路；不含启动、PSRR、修调、电阻温漂、失配及输出负载。
models.parameter_origin_en: Demonstration assumptions; SI constants k and q are exact.
models.parameter_origin_zh: 数值为演示假设；SI常数k与q采用精确定义。

models.equation_en: Splain=en^2(1+fc/f); Ssuppressed=en^2(2+fc/(f+fchop)); variance=integral S(f)df; sampled variance=kT/C.
models.equation_zh: 演示抑制低频噪声时的白噪声代价；另列采样热噪声。

parameters.integration_method: Analytic PSD antiderivatives; saved frequency grid unchanged

models.limits_en: Illustrative spectral shaping, not a switched chopper circuit or measured op amp. No current noise, source resistance, aliasing, ripple or charge injection.
models.limits_zh: 仅示意频谱整形，不是开关斩波电路或实测运放；不含电流噪声、源阻、混叠、纹波和电荷注入。
models.parameter_origin_en: Demonstration assumptions; SI constants k and q are exact.
models.parameter_origin_zh: 数值为演示假设；SI常数k与q采用精确定义。

models.equation_en: Binary CDAC with dummy; actual sequential-decision transition search; DNL from code widths; INL fitted to first/last internal transitions; coherent 16384-point FFT, bin 503, one-sided power with DC/Nyquist counted once.
models.equation_zh: 含dummy的二进制CDAC逐位比较；搜索实际转换码边界计算DNL，首末内部转换点端点拟合计算INL；相干FFT单边功率对直流与奈奎斯特点只计一次。
models.limits_en: Ideal comparator and full settling. No aperture jitter, thermal/comparator noise, switch leakage, reference droop or supply-current prediction. Capacitor mismatch is assumed.
models.limits_zh: 比较器理想且完全建立；不含采样抖动、热噪声/比较器噪声、开关漏电、参考跌落及供电电流预测；电容失配为假设。
models.parameter_origin_en: Demonstration assumptions; SI constants k and q are exact.
models.parameter_origin_zh: 数值为演示假设；SI常数k与q采用精确定义。

models.equation_zh: 二状态线性反馈模型，输出负载阶跃、环路增益和相位裕度。
models.limits_en: Small perturbation around a biased operating point; no dropout, current limit, start-up, ESR zero or transistor netlist. Not a reproduction of the cited measured LDO.
models.limits_zh: 围绕偏置点的小扰动模型；无压差极限、限流、启动、ESR零点或晶体管网表；并非复现引用论文的实测LDO。
models.parameter_origin_en: Demonstration assumptions; SI constants k and q are exact.
models.parameter_origin_zh: 数值为演示假设；SI常数k与q采用精确定义。

models.equation_en: H(s)=wn^2/(s^2+2 zeta wn s+wn^2); Sout=|H|^2 Sref+|1-H|^2 Svco; jitter=sqrt(integral Sout df)/(2 pi fcarrier).
models.equation_zh: 典型二阶相位响应与互补噪声传递，区分单边相位PSD和SSB噪声。
models.limits_en: Canonical phase-domain abstraction without a loop zero. Not a transistor VCO, a full type-II PLL, ISF extraction, cycle-slip or acquisition simulation.
models.limits_zh: 无环路零点的典型相位域抽象；不是晶体管VCO、完整二型PLL、ISF提取、周跳或捕获仿真。
models.parameter_origin_en: Demonstration assumptions; SI constants k and q are exact.
models.parameter_origin_zh: 数值为演示假设；SI常数k与q采用精确定义。

models.equation_en: L di/dt=u Vin-(Rsw+RL)i-v; C dv/dt=i-v/Rload. Exact period-map initialization; exact piecewise affine propagation and 16-point phasewise Gauss integration; input-output-loss-energy balance.
models.equation_zh: 解析周期映射初始化、精确分段仿射传播及16点Gauss积分；校核输入、输出、导通损耗和储能。

parameters.state_propagation: Exact affine exponential; periodic warmup traversal unnecessary

models.limits_en: Forced CCM with ideal instantaneous switches. Efficiency includes conduction loss only; no switching/gate/core loss, dead time, ringing, control-loop start-up, SOA or validated voltage rating.
models.limits_zh: 强制连续导通、理想瞬时开关；效率仅含导通损耗；无开关/栅极/磁芯损耗、死区、振铃、控制启动、SOA或已验证耐压。
models.parameter_origin_en: Demonstration assumptions; SI constants k and q are exact.
models.parameter_origin_zh: 数值为演示假设；SI常数k与q采用精确定义。

conventions.current: Positive into the modeled device/block. Unmodeled electrical ports are absent, never silently zero.
conventions.power: sum(Vterminal * Iterminal), W; includes storage and dissipation; not automatically heat.
conventions.source: All numerical parameters assumed; no PDK, TCAD or measured-fit validation.

numerical_scope_en: Numerical evaluation upgrades of unchanged reduced equations, not +10% physical-model accuracy. See accuracy_audit.json for metric-specific results and N/A cases.
numerical_scope_zh: 提升既有简化方程的数值求解，不代表物理模型准确度提升10%；各指标结果及不适用项见accuracy_audit.json。
